title: Hubble Interacting Galaxy UGC 8335
caption: Interacting galaxy pair UGC 8335 (Arp 238), imaged by the Hubble Space Telescope
celestial: UGC 8335, VV 250a, Arp 238, KPG 369B · constellation Ursa Major · about 400 million light-years away (source figure)
credit: NASA, ESA, the Hubble Heritage (STScI/AURA)-ESA/Hubble Collaboration, and A. Evans (University of Virginia, Charlottesville/NRAO/Stony Brook University)

recognition.text: NASA Hubble image release (STScI). No published audience rating.

story: The two spiral galaxies of UGC 8335 resemble a pair of ice skaters. A bridge of material links them, two strongly curved tails of gas and stars sweep out from their outer parts, and dark dust lanes cross the centres of both. The pair is the 238th entry in Arp's Atlas of Peculiar Galaxies.

The bridge and tails are tidal features. When two galaxies pass close, each pulls harder on the near side of its partner than on the far side, stretching stars and gas from the outer disc into long streams. NASA describes the pair as strongly interacting, and here the bridge physically unites the two galaxies.

About 400 million light-years from Earth, UGC 8335 lies in the constellation Ursa Major, the Great Bear. The image belongs to a collection of merging systems released in April 2008 on the telescope's 18th launch anniversary. NASA notes that collisions like this unfold over several hundred million years, far too slowly to see change over a human lifetime.

understand.summary: Hubble's Advanced Camera for Surveys used a blue filter, F435W (B), and a near-infrared filter, F814W (I). NASA shows F435W in blue, F814W in red, and a blend of the two in green.
understand.eye: Near-infrared light is invisible to the eye, and the 36-minute exposure gathers far more light than the eye can.

explore: The galaxies are also catalogued as VV 250a and Arp 238. Most of the 2008 anniversary images were part of GOALS, a survey of luminous and ultra-luminous infrared galaxies that combines Hubble with other NASA observatories.
alt: Two spiral galaxies joined by a bridge of material, each with a strongly curved tail and dark dust lanes across its centre.
